snippet.title: MISERY DUNGEON - DEMO TRAILER #2
snippet.description:
Misery Dungeon is a top-down, hand drawn (no AI), narrative tactical RPG.
Play as Kern, princess of the Arelkrov kingdom, and her loyal squire, in a quest to reach the mysterious « Gift of the Old Earth ». To achieve it, you’ll need to make it to the summit of the Mountain Kto'lmaa.
By mastering the magic flowing in your body, you’ll be able to attain heights no one ever explored.
By understanding the behaviours of the entities living in the dungeon, you’ll be able to defeat, or avoid, them.
But most importantly, you’ll need to know your allies to avoid making them opponents.

Go play the demo on Steam!
